senses.gloss: f. (זוּז) shaking, perturbation (v. P. Sm. 4416 s. v. תו) רוח ת׳ demon of restlessness, epilepsy, madness. Pesik. Par., p. 40ᵃ, sq.; Pesik. R. s. 14; Num. R. s. 198; Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 8 ח׳ (corr. acc.); ed. Bub. 26.
units: Y. Yoma VIII, 45ᵇ top רוח ח׳ עולה עליו (corr. acc.) the demon t’zazith enters into him (the mad dog).
Gen. R. s. 12 ת׳ וכ׳(של)הקב״ה … רוח God causes the demon t’zazith to enter into her (the hind), and she knocks &c. (v. קִרְקֵשׁ); Yalk. Ps. 862; Midr. Sam. ch. IX ריח חאות (corr. acc.); a. e.
